author: D.Schaefli

title: Proof that High Standards still exist in App Development!
body:
Hey Mykola, I just wanted to thank you for this great app, and for your commitment to good practice!

- No platitudes and empty words, just a clean and simple UI!
- No bloat. Just one page for all essentials.
- Lets me export my data as .csv, no lock-in!
author: Ben..M
